First Fiduciary Investment Counsel Inc increased its stake in Wells Fargo (WFC) by 2.9% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. First Fiduciary Investment Counsel Inc bought 12,235 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.66% while stock markets rallied. The institutional investor held 434,564 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $23.97 million, up from 422,329 at the end of the previous reported quarter. First Fiduciary Investment Counsel Inc who had been investing in Wells Fargo for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $290.49B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.98% or $0.585 during the last trading session, reaching $59.385. About 13.01M shares traded. Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) has risen 9.67% since February 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 7.03% the S&P500.

(NYSE:BGS) has declined 7.13% since February 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.83% the S&P500.
